organization: Government of Singapore (Ministries of Education, National Development, Sustainability and the Environment, Trade and Industry, Transport)
notes: Green Plan is a whole-of-nation movement with 5 pillars: City in Nature, Energy Reset, Sustainable Living, Green Economy, Resilient Future. Stated targets include 1 million more trees, quadruple solar deployment by 2025, 30% less waste to landfill by 2030, at least 20% of schools carbon neutral by 2030, cleaner-energy vehicles from 2030, and net zero aspiration by 2050. Budget figures for the Resilient Future pillar: not stated on this page.
